entries.zh: 慌忙，仓促而无所斟酌（西语 sin tiento：不加掂量）
entries.en: hastily, in a flurry; without care or caution

entries.zh: 急迫；催逼过甚、令人不胜其扰
entries.en: to rush or press someone excessively; importunately, inopportunely

entries.zh: 吟诵课文，诵读时加意于声调
entries.en: to intone a lesson; to give the accent to what is read

entries.zh: 把字音读得清亮分明（「金玉音」喻吐字清越）
entries.en: to articulate the words clearly and distinctly (lit. "gold-and-jade sounds")
entries.notes: M 栏多出 siá̃ 一音节，四栏不全对应；「金玉音」为成语性表述，按吐字清越义释。
H 栏原字残疑（鉋/敲），据 M「cáuᶜ」及次条「刀」定为木作「鉋」，R 音近「敲」存异。

entries.en: to plane with a plane; a plane iron
entries.notes: 承前条，H 残疑作「鉋刀」；R 作 toǔn 与 M「tó」不合，释义以 H+M 为据。

entries.zh: 刨光、打磨平整（木料刨至白净底面）
entries.en: to plane smooth; to finish (wood) to a clean surface
entries.notes: 「做白地」为木作俗语，与西语「精细刨光」属意译对应。

entries.zh: 承允，接受（他人所许之诺）

entries.en: to receive and accept; to take upon oneself
partial; a respecter of persons, one who shows favoritism
entries.notes: M 栏「lay giáᶜ」在 H/R 无对应，疑为附注音写；核心义据西语 aceptador de personas（偏待人）与 H「私」定。

entries.zh: 看人大小眼，待人有厚薄（势利偏心）
entries.en: partial, favoring the great over the small; snobbish favoritism
partiality, favoritism (treating some warmly and others coldly)
to hit the mark; to guess right, to be correct

entries.zh: 恰巧捉准，正合心意（合口味）
entries.en: to hit exactly on what pleases; to get it exactly right
entries.notes: 「執个着」为闽南语「捉准、恰中」的俗语，西语取「合口味」义，属意译对应。

entries.zh: 猜中，灵验（占测、猜度得准）
entries.en: to guess right; to be efficacious in divination
to hit the target; to hit the mark
